notes.subject: מהיכלך על ירושלם
notes.rationale: 'I ka so Yerushalayim kan' — sira fila: so min bɛ Yerushalayim kan (KJV/ASV) walima so min bɛ Yerushalayim bɔ (Geneva: 'so la, Yerushalayim fɛ')

notes.subject: היכל
notes.rationale: Heburukan kɔrɔ ye masasɔrɔba walima jɔso ye; an ye 'so' ta dɔrɔn, sabu Bamanankan tɛ daɲɛ tilennen don tempɛli kama

notes.subject: ⟨ni⟩
notes.rationale: Bamanankan ka kan ka 'di' ɲɛsin fɛn di ma, Heburukan ma min fɔ

translation: I ka so la min bɛ Yerushalayim (Jerusalɛmu) kan, masakɛw bɛ ⟨ni⟩ di-fɛnw di i ye.
